scope: Per-question routing policies scored on cached closed-book and RAG outputs; no new generation.
inference: Every policy is compared against the better fixed policy (always- or never-retrieve) by a PAIRED quiz-clustered bootstrap of the per-question difference, Holm-corrected across the nine generators.
gold_conditioned_are_not_policies: GOLD_STRING and GOLD_NLI use the gold answer. They are diagnostics, not deployable rules, and neither is an upper bound: GOLD_STRING is below always-retrieve for one generator and below the lexical gate for two.
ceiling: PERQ_BEST -- retrieve iff that raises this question's score -- is the per-question upper bound over all deterministic gates, so recovered fractions are at most 1 and are defined for every generator.
cross_fitting: 20 repeated two-fold splits over the 199 quizzes; each fold's threshold is tuned on the complementary fold, so every question is scored under a threshold that never saw it.

ceiling_recovery.definition: (best deployable gate - better fixed policy) / (per-question best - better fixed policy); every generator is included and the ratio cannot exceed 1

overlap_summary.statement: The lexical-overlap gate does NOT improve every generator: report the number with intervals excluding zero after Holm correction, and report the generators where it does not.
